title: torch.compile regression: mxfp8 quantization along rows
bug_description:
### 🐛 Describe the bug

## Summary
- Sometime between 09/12 and 09/30, torch.compile has had a major regression in the performance of inductor codgen for mxfp8 quantization along rows- i.e., (1 x block_size) scaling granularity

## Repro

1. Use machine with B200 GPUs and cuda 12.8
2. Install torch nightly build for cuda 12.8: `pip3 install --pre torch --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu128` 
2. Clone torchao `git clone git@github.com:pytorch/ao.git`
3. Run benchmark: `cd ao/benchmarks/mx_formats`
4. `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 python cast_bench.py --mode dim0_mxfp8_floor`
5. See ~1485gbps:
```
(torch) [danvm@devgpu007.snb3 ~/ao/benchmarks/mx_formats (mx-a2a-2)]$ CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 python cast_bench.py --mode dim0_mxfp8_floor
M 16384 K 16384 BLOCK_SIZE 32
GPU: NVIDIA B200
torch version: 2.10.0.[dev20250930](https://l.workplace.com/l.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.internalfb.com%2Fintern%2Fbunny%2F%3Fq%3Ddev20250930&h=AT3oNVz-GDTWsBu4uQV0JnkMocQLFmUI0vZFep5jacZOZsfQWFsUIunKLKusdxT9qpSa1BjidHVSCdH4ClhuNFQiqN7UJM_3tSoiRNyXK8YGz7Vd3FTiCoOhUeTFp4nT-72p4WKZTDnY7d8ok8i4Iw)+cu128
triton version: 3.5.0
mode: dim0_mxfp8_floor
time_us 547.7439761161804
mem_bw_gbps 1485.5388858305025
```


Now using older nightly from 09/12 and see ~5600gbps:

```
(torch) [danvm@devgpu007.snb3 ~/ao/benchmarks/mx_formats (mx-a2a-2)]$ CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=7 python cast_bench.py --mode dim0_mxfp8_floor
M 16384 K 16384 BLOCK_SIZE 32
GPU: NVIDIA B200
torch version: 2.10.0.dev20250912+cu128
triton version: 3.5.0
mode: dim0_mxfp8_floor
time_us 144.31999623775482
mem_bw_gbps 5638.1305239192725
```

### Versions

- torch                     2.10.0.dev20250930+cu128
- torchao latest main branch
